verdict.rationale: Graphite is a code-review and stacked-PR platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. It documents one: GT MCP, at its own docs page, lets AI agents create stacked PRs and break large AI-generated changes into reviewable stacks. The MCP offering also appears on the pricing page. Missing for 10: documented connection/setup steps and supported clients, the full set of exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
